# che-packages

che's package catalog: `packages.yml` declaring every package, its install methods per manager and platform, and its verify commands, plus the `scripts/` those entries reference. Published as a versioned definitions tarball che fetches and embeds. A pytest suite proves each package installs for real, one throwaway container per (package, method).

> **Migration in progress.** `go-modules/che-packages/` still holds the catalog che
> embeds today. This repo carries a copy. Until the go-modules cutover MR lands,
> author catalog changes there, not here.

## Layout

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `packages.yml` | The catalog: `osInstallers`, `basePackages`, `toolPackages`, `packages` |
| `packages.schema.json` | JSON Schema, generated by che from its Go models |
| `scripts/` | Post-install scripts `packages.yml` entries reference by path |
| `tests/catalog.py` | Catalog parsing, method resolution, verify-command derivation |
| `tests/runner.py` | The docker runner: one container per (package, method) |
| `tests/test_catalog.py` | Fast validation, no docker |
| `tests/test_install.py` | Real installs, needs docker and a che binary |
| `ci/publish-packages-defs.zsh` | Tag-pipeline publish to the generic package registry |

## Testing

Fast validation, no docker, runs automatically on every MR:

```sh
make test-catalog
```

Real installs. Each case runs `che packages install --only-methods <method> <pkg>`
in a fresh `debian:bookworm-slim` container, then runs the verify commands derived
from the entry:

```sh
make fetch-che                              # download the linux che binary
make test-install PACKAGE=fd METHOD=apt     # one package, one method
make test-install PACKAGE=fd                # one package, every method it declares
make test-install-auto                      # the automatic tier only
make test-install                           # the whole catalog
```

`TARGET_ARCH=arm64` selects the arch. `CHE_E2E_AUTO_PER_METHOD` (default 2) sets
how many packages per method land in the automatic tier.

## Pipeline

Two install stages, split by cost:

- **`test-install-auto`** — automatic on every MR, both arches. The first
  `CHE_E2E_AUTO_PER_METHOD` packages of each method, so every install method is
  proven live without a full-catalog matrix.
- **`test-install-manual`** — one optional manual job per package per arch,
  generated from `packages.yml`. Untriggered jobs never block. Set `METHOD` at
  trigger time to narrow a job to one method.

`validate-catalog` gates both: schema validation plus every entry's methods and
verify commands resolving.

## Releases

A `v<version>` tag publishes `che-packages_v<version>.tar.gz` (`packages.yml` +
`scripts/`) with a `checksums.txt` to the generic package registry, links both as
release assets, and refreshes the moving `latest/` alias plus `version.txt` that
`che packages update` reads.
